mapper.select: SELECT comment_id::TEXT AS row_id, post_id, p_comment_id, context, good_cnt, bad_cnt, (SELECT u.nickname FROM member u WHERE u.member_id = comment.reg_id) AS reg_name, (SELECT u.handle FROM member u WHERE u.member_id = comment.reg_id) AS reg_handle, (CASE WHEN #{viewerId}::text IS NOT NULL AND comment.reg_id = #{viewerId} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS mine_yn, (SELECT u.profile_file_id FROM member u WHERE u.member_id = comment.reg_id) AS reg_profile_file_id, (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM content_like l WHERE l.target_type = 'COMMENT' AND l.target_id = comment.comment_id AND l.member_id = #{viewerId}) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS liked_yn, TO_CHAR(reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS reg_dt FROM comment WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND post_id = #{postId}::integer AND NOT EXISTS ( -- 내가 차단한 회원의 댓글은 내 화면에서 제외 SELECT 1 FROM member_block ub WHERE ub.member_id = #{viewerId} AND ub.blocked_id = comment.reg_id ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN p_comment_id = 0 THEN comment_id ELSE p_comment_id END, -- 스레드(부모) 기준 CASE WHEN p_comment_id = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, -- 부모 먼저, 답글 뒤 comment_id
SELECT comment_id::TEXT AS row_id, post_id, context, reg_id FROM comment WHERE comment_id = #{rowId}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (post_id, p_comment_id, context, good_cnt, bad_cnt, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{postId}::integer, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{pCommentId}, '')::integer, 0), #{context}, 0, 0, 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE comment SET context = #{context}, upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE comment_id = #{rowId}::integer
UPDATE comment SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE comment_id = #{rowId}::integer
